changes.to: Maker product page lists TR-WORKS as its next-generation humanoid for semiconductor and display process logistics; the figures come from the company's statements at its first public showing (Automation World 2026, 2026-03-04): height 180 cm, weight 180 kg, payload 3 kg, 20 DOF (arms 14, body/legs 4, AMR 2), 55 cm up-down travel, +/-45-degree bending, +/-180-degree torso rotation, an AMR base with FMS integration, 3-finger and 2-finger interchangeable hands, teleoperation and VR teaching, imitation learning and RFM zero-shot recognition; the company plans to raise payload to 20-30 kg. Speed, battery and runtime are not published. Status is Prototype: it was exhibited and is being tested in the company's own lines and in a government project with a display maker and KAIST through 2030.
TR-WORKS is T-Robotics' process-logistics humanoid for semiconductor and display lines: an AMR base with a 20-DOF body, 3 kg payload and vacuum-robot precision motion.
